BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

2. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.

3. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

6. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.

7. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

8. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.

9. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.

10. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.

13. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.

14. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

16. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Foundation Walling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
